system.description:
A freelance mounted warrior fighting for coin, not a sworn order.

  • Cavalry Strike: while mounted, you can split your mount's movement before and after your attack.
  • The creature you attack can't make an Attack of Opportunity against you or your mount for that movement.
  • Your mount has Advantage on saves against fear while you ride it.
  • Soldier's Rep: Advantage on Persuasion when negotiating pay or contracts. Reputation among mercenary companies and caravan guilds.
